body_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted | ANC (African National Congress)
Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result

The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.

Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to voters turning away from the party .

The former liberation movement is projected to lose its status as the biggest party in the two most populous provinces, Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal, as parties began coalition negotiations behind closed doors. The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.

The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result. The centre-right, white-led Democratic Alliance (DA) had 24.1% of the vote, while the uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party of the former ANC president Jacob Zuma was on 9.3%.
Turnout also rose in Wednesday’s poll. The election commission estimated that 54.5% of registered voters cast their ballot, up from 46% five years ago.

The final shape of coalitions in some of the country’s biggest cities remained unclear with the final votes still being counted. Senior figures in key parties said they would talk with almost anyone, while keeping negotiating strategies under wraps.

In Johannesburg, South Africa’s commercial capital and biggest city, with 4.8 million people, voters have had to contend with regular water and power cuts , uncollected rubbish and potholes. The municipality, which has seen 10 changes of mayor in the last decade amid unstable coalitions, has admitted to a 220bn rand (£9.9bn) infrastructure spending backlog.

With just over half of votes counted in Johannesburg, the DA was leading with 40%, having run an energetic campaign under Helen Zille, a 75-year-old former Cape Town mayor. The ANC, which leads the current coalition, was in second place on 17.5%. ActionSA, a rightwing party led by Herman Mashaba, was on 15.5%. Mashaba has pledged never to work with Zille, whom he calls “racist”, something she vehemently denies.

Many of the ANC’s township strongholds have yet to report full results. The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), a respected thinktank, has projected the DA will finish with 34%, the ANC 20% and ActionSA 16.8%.
Coalitions in Gauteng’s three city municipalities are often negotiated together. The DA is leading in all three.

The MK party, led by 84-year-old Zuma as he continues to weather and deny numerous corruption allegations, is expected to displace the ANC as the largest party in KwaZulu-Natal. Founded in 2023, it mixes socially conservative Zulu nationalism with pledges to redistribute land and wealth from white to black South Africans.

With half of votes counted in eThekwini municipality, which contains Durban, the MK had 41%, meaning other parties could form a coalition to keep it out of power. Meanwhile, the DA is projected to maintain its majority in Cape Town, despite growing middle-class anger over rising housing costs .
Voters choose a local councillor and a party, with seats allocated via proportional representation. Councillors will then have two weeks to elect mayors and form municipal governments.
body_zh: 非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中遭遇惨败，80%的选票已清点ANC（非洲人国民大会）
前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中势必遭遇惨败，纳尔逊·曼德拉(Nelson Mandela)领导的一度占主导地位的政党在全国选票已计入超过80%的情况下，其得票率跌至三分之一以下。
周三零散的投票标志着非国大衰落的又一个阶段。自1994年白人少数种族隔离统治结束以来，非国大一直领导着各国政府。高失业率、犯罪、腐败和糟糕的当地服务交付都导致选民远离该党。
随着各党派开始闭门进行联合谈判，前解放运动预计将失去豪登省和夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省这两个人口最多省份最大政党的地位。最终结果预计将于周日公布。
非国大在全国的选票率为 31.8%，比 2021 年地方选举的结果低近 14 个百分点。白人领导的中右翼民主联盟 (DA) 获得 24.1% 的选票，而前非国大主席雅各布·祖马 (Jacob Zuma) 领导的 uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) 政党则获得 9.3% 的选票。
周三的民意调查的投票率也有所上升。选举委员会估计，54.5% 的登记选民参加了投票，高于五年前的 46%。
该国一些最大城市的联盟的最终形态仍不清楚，最终选票仍在统计中。主要政党的高级人士表示，他们几乎会与任何人交谈，同时对谈判策略保密。
在拥有 480 万人口的南非商业首都和最大城市约翰内斯堡，选民不得不面对经常断水断电、垃圾无人收集和坑坑洼洼的问题。在过去十年中，由于联盟不稳定，该市已经更换了 10 次市长，并承认有 2200 亿兰特（99 亿英镑）的基础设施支出积压。

约翰内斯堡的选票已清点一半多一点，地方检察官在 75 岁的开普敦前市长海伦·齐勒 (Helen Zille) 的领导下开展了一场充满活力的竞选活动，以 40% 的得票率领先。领导当前联盟的非国大以 17.5% 的支持率位居第二。由赫尔曼·马沙巴 (Herman Mashaba) 领导的右翼政党 ActionSA 的支持率为 15.5%。马沙巴承诺永远不会与齐勒合作，他称齐勒为“种族主义者”，但她强烈否认这一点。
非国大的许多乡镇据点尚未报告完整结果。受人尊敬的智囊团科学与工业研究委员会 (CSIR) 预计 DA 将获得 34%、ANC 20% 和 ActionSA 16.8%。
豪登省三个城市的联盟经常一起谈判。 DA 在这三个方面都处于领先地位。
由 84 岁的祖马领导的 MK 党继续经受住并否认众多腐败指控，预计将取代非国大成为夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省最大政党。它成立于 2023 年，将社会保守的祖鲁民族主义与将土地和财富从南非白人重新分配给黑人的承诺结合在一起。
德班所在的 eThekwini 市已计票一半，MK 获得 41% 的选票，这意味着其他政党可以组成联盟来阻止其掌权。与此同时，尽管中产阶级对不断上涨的住房成本越来越愤怒，但预计DA仍将在开普敦保持多数席位。
选民选出一名地方议员和一个政党，席位通过比例代表制分配。然后，议员们将有两周时间选举市长并组建市政府。

title_en: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
title_zh: 法国血库遭受网络攻击后，健康情报共享组织向业界发出警告
summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.
summary_zh: 一家医疗保健情报共享组织警告其成员在冷存储系统遭受网络攻击后锁定系统，其中包括
body_en: A close up of the hands of a nurse from the French Blood Establishment checking the identification and traceability of blood samples beside a donor during a mobile blood donation session in Paimpol Cotes d Armor Brittany France on July 23, 2026. Helene Rigny/Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images hide caption

In a new security bulletin, the information sharing and analysis center devoted to the healthcare industry, Health ISAC, alerted members to a recent wave of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration controllers — including one incident that affected a major French blood bank.

"This alert is issued for situational awareness, highlighting how recent operational technology (OT) attacks against specific refrigeration brands directly intersect with emerging threats to the health sector," reads the bulletin seen by NPR. Operational technology refers to the machines that control physical processes in the real world, from cooling systems to water pumps.
A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe

Cyberattacks on grocery stores and food processing plants everywhere from Europe and Israel to U.S. military bases have drawn headlines in recent months, particularly as attacks have resulted in spoiled food, fires, broken machinery, and major business disruptions. Attackers are clearly aware of the vulnerability of these systems and are taking advantage.

However, until news broke that the French blood bank, known as the French Blood Establishment, had also been targeted, there was less public attention focused on the potential consequences of refrigeration controllers failing in other industries, particularly healthcare, where lifesaving implements like blood and vaccines often require finely tuned temperature-controlled environments to remain viable.

"This incident underscores a stark operational reality: cybersecurity in healthcare is fundamentally about patient safety," wrote Errol Weiss, the chief security officer at Health ISAC in an email to NPR. "When threat actors manipulate operational technology like cold-chain storage and refrigeration units holding donor blood, plasma, or critical therapies, they aren't merely stealing data or locking down administrative files, they are directly endangering the physical resources required to sustain human life."

On Thursday, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, the FBI, the Department of Health and Human Services, and the U.S. Department of Agriculture published their own fact sheet about threats to industrial refrigeration and cold chain monitoring systems, tools they identify as critical to multiple industries from healthcare to chemical production, food and agriculture, and transportation.

The FBI Cyber Branch Operations director, Brett Leatherman, said the bureau is tracking bad actors targeting these systems "across critical infrastructure sectors globally, putting inventory and equipment at risk."

"Industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems protect food, medicine, and other temperature-sensitive products, making them attractive targets for malicious cyber actors," Leatherman said.
Are hacks of U.S. water facilities a new front in the Iran war?

The French blood bank confirmed in a press release Tuesday that one of its vendors used in cold storage rooms was targeted by malicious cyber activity, resulting in the defrost and temperature thresholds being raised dangerously high. The French Blood Establishment ultimately managed to detect the suspicious activity in time to rescue blood samples.
It remains unclear who is responsible for the global attacks on refrigeration controllers, and whether it's multiple actors or groups.

Iran has been linked to at least one incident in Israel earlier in the spring, though that breach involved a lot more sophistication and malicious activity. Investigators probing the disruptions at U.S. military bases are also considering Iran as the potential culprit.

Meanwhile, two pro-Russian hacking groups, NoName057(16) and Z-Pentest Alliance, belatedly released videos and posted on Telegram claiming responsibility for the attacks across Europe, publishing a sample of alleged hacked credentials that would've allowed them to access equipment including machines made by the Danish company Danfoss and the American company Copeland. Those machines can monitor and control temperature and other functions. The hacking groups have some history of targeting refrigeration controllers and other operational technology. However, it's unclear if the recent wave of attacks on refrigerators and freezers across Europe even required stolen credentials to execute, a factor that has led some cybersecurity experts to be skeptical of their claims.

Even so, it will require more evidence like access logs, configuration changes, and connections between maintenance accounts on the controllers to make any clear assessments, explained Tom Hegel, who leads threat intelligence research at cybersecurity firm SentinelOne.

"Russian-aligned actors are a credible hypothesis because there is a credible precedent, including the refrigeration-related attack DOJ attributed to CyberArmyofRussia_Reborn and NoName's history of politically motivated disruption. But that is only the context, not the missing evidentiary link to these European incidents," Hegel told NPR.
"It's important to note that such Russian threat actors often seek attention and claim to cause incidents even when false," he continued.
Regardless of who's responsible, the incident highlights how these nearly ubiquitous tools used to remotely manage critical systems are vulnerable to attack in several different ways.
body_zh: 2026 年 7 月 23 日，在法国布列塔尼潘波勒阿莫尔丘陵举行的流动献血活动中，法国血液机构的一名护士在检查捐献者身边血样的识别和可追溯性时，她的手部特写。Helene Rigny/Hans Lucas/法新社（盖蒂图片社）隐藏标题栏
在一份新的安全公告中，致力于医疗保健行业的信息共享和分析中心 Health ISAC 提醒成员注意最近一波针对制冷控制器的网络攻击，其中包括影响法国一家主要血库的事件。
NPR 看到的公告称：“发布此警报是为了态势感知，强调最近针对特定制冷品牌的操作技术 (OT) 攻击如何与卫生部门面临的新威胁直接交叉。”运营技术是指控制现实世界中从冷却系统到水泵等物理过程的机器。
新冷战：黑客瞄准全球冰箱
近几个月来，从欧洲、以色列到美国军事基地，针对杂货店和食品加工厂的网络攻击已成为头条新闻，特别是因为攻击导致食品变质、火灾、机械损坏和重大业务中断。攻击者清楚地意识到这些系统的漏洞并正在利用这些漏洞。
然而，直到法国血库（即法国血液机构）也成为攻击目标的消息传出之前，公众很少关注制冷控制器故障对其他行业（尤其是医疗保健行业）的潜在后果，因为在医疗保健行业，血液和疫苗等救生工具通常需要精细调节的温度控制环境才能保持活力。
Health ISAC 首席安全官埃罗尔·韦斯 (Errol Weiss) 在给 NPR 的电子邮件中写道：“这一事件凸显了一个严峻的操作现实：医疗保健中的网络安全从根本上关系到患者的安全。” “当威胁行为者操纵保存捐献血液、血浆或关键疗法的冷链存储和制冷装置等操作技术时，他们不仅仅是窃取数据或锁定管理文件，而是直接危及维持人类生命所需的物理资源。”
周四，网络安全和基础设施安全局、联邦调查局、卫生与公众服务部和美国农业部发布了自己的情况说明书，内容涉及工业制冷和冷链监控系统所面临的威胁，他们认为这些工具对医疗保健、化学品生产、食品和农业以及运输等多个行业至关重要。
联邦调查局网络部门运营总监布雷特·莱瑟曼 (Brett Leatherman) 表示，该局正在追踪“全球关键基础设施部门”针对这些系统的不良行为者，使库存和设备面临风险。
“工业制冷和冷链监控系统可以保护食品、药品和其他温度敏感产品，使它们成为恶意网络攻击者的有吸引力的目标，”莱瑟曼说。
对美国供水设施的黑客攻击是伊朗战争的新战线吗？
法国血库周二在一份新闻稿中证实，其冷藏室使用的一家供应商受到恶意网络活动的攻击，导致除霜和温度阈值被提高到危险的高度。法国血液机构最终及时发现了可疑活动，抢救了血液样本。
目前尚不清楚谁应对全球制冷控制器攻击负责，也不清楚是否是多个参与者或团体。
伊朗与今年春天早些时候在以色列发生的至少一起事件有关，尽管那次泄露涉及更复杂的恶意活动。调查美国军事基地中断事件的调查人员也认为伊朗是潜在的罪魁祸首。

与此同时，两个亲俄罗斯的黑客组织 NoName057(16) 和 Z-Pentest Alliance 迟来地发布了视频并在 Telegram 上发布，声称对整个欧洲的攻击负责，并发布了一份涉嫌被黑客入侵的凭证样本，这些凭证允许他们访问包括丹麦公司 Danfoss 和美国公司 Copeland 制造的设备在内的设备。这些机器可以监视和控制温度和其他功能。黑客组织有一些针对制冷控制器和其他操作技术的历史。然而，目前尚不清楚最近一波针对欧洲各地冰箱和冰柜的攻击是否需要窃取凭据才能执行，这一因素导致一些网络安全专家对其说法表示怀疑。
网络安全公司 SentinelOne 威胁情报研究负责人 Tom Hegel 解释说，即便如此，仍需要更多证据，例如访问日志、配置更改以及控制器上维护帐户之间的连接，才能做出明确的评估。
“与俄罗斯结盟的行为者是一个可信的假设，因为有一个可信的先例，包括司法部归因于 Cyber​​ArmyofRussia_Reborn 的制冷相关攻击以及 NoName 出于政治动机的破坏历史。但这只是背景，而不是与这些欧洲事件缺失的证据联系，”黑格尔告诉 NPR。
他继续说道：“值得注意的是，此类俄罗斯威胁行为者经常寻求关注并声称造成事件，即使是虚假的。”
无论责任人是谁，该事件都凸显了这些几乎无处不在的用于远程管理关键系统的工具如何容易受到多种不同方式的攻击。

title_en: Dozens of Democrats eyeing 2028 presidential run, says former Obama aide
title_zh: 前奥巴马助手表示，数十名民主党人正在考虑参加 2028 年总统竞选
summary: Jim Messina tells the BBC that after Democrats' midterm victories he's talked to "over two dozen campaigns", with some already hiring staff.
summary_zh: 吉姆·梅西纳 (Jim Messina) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，民主党取得中期胜利后，他与“超过二十个竞选团队”进行了交谈，其中一些已经在招聘工作人员。
body_en: More than two dozen Democrats are eyeing runs for the White House in 2028, following their party's success in the US midterm elections this week, according to the man behind Barack Obama's successful re-election bid.

Jim Messina, who led Obama's 2012 campaign, said that since Democrats saw major victories in congressional races as well as state elections, he's spoken to "over two dozen campaigns" that are actively considering running in 2028 and have begun the financing process and hiring staff.
"I think you're going to start having Democrats announce exploratory committees next week or the next couple of weeks, probably after Thanksgiving", Messina told the BBC's Americast podcast.
He said he already knows someone relocating to work on a governor's presidential campaign.
He also predicted that the number could shrink as candidates faced pressure to raise large sums needed for the primary contests that will decide the party's nominee.

Messina gave some insight into the conversations he's had, saying: "When I sit down with candidates or their campaigns, I say to them, 'Tell me your economic vision for the future of this country. What are you going to do on AI?'"
Then there's another factor: the outgoing president, Donald Trump, who will still be in office during the campaign season.
"And so, do the Democrats take the bait and talk about Donald Trump every day, or do you stay focused on your message?" he said.
"It's going be the most interesting presidential [election] since 2008."
Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress

Messina, who went on to become Obama's deputy chief of staff at the White House, said the party's success in the US midterm elections was down to their ability to stay focused on the economy and the effect of Donald Trump's tariffs, which were "devastating to rural voters".
"When you're a farmer and you're paying $7 for a gallon of diesel to put in your tractor, the economics just don't work, and at the same time you're paying more for everything," he said.
PODCAST: Hear more from Jim Messina on Americast
Staying on message about the economy helped them flip seats in traditionally strong Republican states like Iowa, Kansas, and Texas, he said.

"The common criticism of Democrats is that we can't stick to one message. And for the first time in a very long time, Democrats stuck to the economy. They didn't take the bait on the social wars," he said.
Messina cautioned Democrats that success in this year's midterm elections was not a ringing endorsement of the party and that "the MVP of the election for the Democrats was Donald Trump".
The hard part will now be bringing the party's progressive and centrist wings together in Congress, he said.
'Hopefully things get done': Americans react to historic political shift
body_zh: 据巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 成功竞选连任的幕后黑手透露，继民主党本周在美国中期选举中取得成功后，已有超过 20 名民主党人计划在 2028 年竞选白宫。
领导奥巴马 2012 年竞选活动的吉姆·梅西纳 (Jim Messina) 表示，自从民主党在国会竞选和州选举中取得重大胜利以来，他已经与“超过两打竞选活动”进行了交谈，这些竞选活动正在积极考虑在 2028 年竞选，并已开​​始融资流程和招聘人员。
梅西纳对英国广播公司的美国播客表示：“我认为民主党将在下周或接下来的几周内开始宣布成立探索委员会，可能是在感恩节之后。”
他说他已经认识有人调来为州长总统竞选工作。
他还预测，由于候选人面临着筹集初选所需的大笔资金的压力，而初选将决定该党的提名人，因此这一数字可能会减少。
梅西纳对他的谈话进行了一些深入的了解，他说：“当我与候选人或他们的竞选团队坐下来时，我对他们说，‘告诉我你对这个国家未来的经济愿景。你打算在人工智能方面做什么？’”
还有另一个因素：即将卸任的总统唐纳德·特朗普在竞选季节仍将留任。
“那么，民主党人会上钩并每天谈论唐纳德·特朗普，还是你会专注于你的信息？”他说。
“这将是自 2008 年以来最有趣的总统[选举]。”
2028 年白宫竞选的四个中期要点
民主党入主国会后可以利用新权力做什么和不能做什么
后来成为奥巴马的白宫副幕僚长的梅西纳表示，该党在美国中期选举中的成功取决于他们能够专注于经济和唐纳德·特朗普关税的影响，这“对农村选民来说是毁灭性的”。
他说：“当你是一名农民，花 7 美元购买一加仑拖拉机柴油时，经济上根本行不通，同时你还要为所有东西支付更多费用。”
播客：在 Americast 上聆听吉姆·梅西纳的更多演讲
他说，坚持有关经济的信息有助于他们在爱荷华州、堪萨斯州和德克萨斯州等传统上共和党强势的州翻转席位。
“对民主党的普遍批评是，我们不能坚持一条信息。很长一段时间以来，民主党第一次坚持经济。他们没有上社会战争的当，”他说。
梅西纳警告民主党人，今年中期选举的成功并不是对该党的明确认可，“民主党选举的 MVP 是唐纳德·特朗普”。
他说，现在最困难的部分是让该党的进步派和中间派在国会聚集在一起。

title_en: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
title_zh: 坦桑尼亚反对派领导人因煽动骚乱被判有罪，但叛国罪被无罪释放
summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
summary_zh: 这位 58 岁的男子自去年 4 月以来一直被拘留，他表示这些指控是出于政治动机。
body_en: Tundu Lissu: Tanzania opposition leader found guilty of incitement but acquitted of treason - BBC News
By Wycliffe Muia and Alfred Lasteck , BBC Africa , Reporting from Dar es Salaam

Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, has been found guilty of inciting unrest and sentenced to four years in jail, in a case that has raised concerns about political freedom in the East African country.
A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam acquitted him of the more serious offence of treason, saying prosecutors had failed to prove a key element of that charge.
But they said the 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, had encouraged his supporters to disrupt the disputed 2025 general election.
Lissu, who leads the opposition Chadema party, has denied the charges, describing the prosecution as politically motivated.
The court said his campaign slogan "No Reforms, No Election" was sufficient for him to be convicted of the charge of incitement.
"By uttering those words with the intention of disseminating them to the public, the accused incited the public to disrupt the 2025 elections," the court ruled.
Lissu said he had only been charged with treason, not incitement.
"The offence of incitement is one that you, honourable judges, have manufactured. You have created an offence that did not exist, and you have done so on political directives," Lissu told the court.
He added that he would like to apply for bail as this was possible for incitement, unlike treason.
He has leave to appeal at the Court of Appeal - the country's highest court.
But if the four-year sentence is upheld, it would rule him out of the next elections, due in 2030.
Treason is among Tanzania's most serious offences and can carry the death penalty.
Human rights group Amnesty International described his conviction as a "travesty of justice".
"Tundu Lissu should never have been arrested, let alone prosecuted and convicted," said its regional director for East and Southern Africa, Tigere Chagutah

President Samia Suluhu Hassan won the October 2025 election with 98% of the vote - a result the opposition dismissed the result as a "mockery" of democracy as her two main challengers, including Lissu, were excluded.
Her government has repeatedly denied targeting its opponents.
Tundu Lissu - the great survivor of Tanzanian politics

body_zh: Tundu Lissu：坦桑尼亚反对派领导人被判犯有煽动罪，但叛国罪被宣告无罪 - BBC 新闻
作者：Wycliffe Muia 和 Alfred Lasteck，BBC Africa，达累斯萨拉姆报道
坦桑尼亚主要反对派领导人通杜·利苏被判犯有煽动骚乱罪，被判处四年监禁，此案引发了人们对这个东非国家政治自由的担忧。
达累斯萨拉姆高等法院的三名法官组成的陪审团宣告他无罪，罪名是更严重的叛国罪，称检察官未能证明该指控的关键要素。
但他们表示，这位 58 岁的人自去年 4 月以来一直被拘留，他鼓励他的支持者扰乱有争议的 2025 年大选。
领导反对派查德马党的利苏否认了这些指控，称起诉是出于政治动机。
法院表示，他的竞选口号“没有改革，没有选举”足以让他被判煽动罪。
法院裁定：“被告通过说出这些话并意图向公众传播，煽动公众扰乱 2025 年选举。”
利苏说，他只被指控犯有叛国罪，而不是煽动罪。
“煽动罪是你们，尊敬的法官，制造的。你们创造了一项并不存在的罪行，而且你们是根据政治指令这样做的，”利苏告诉法庭。
他补充说，他想申请保释，因为这可能是煽动行为，而不是叛国罪。
他已获准向该国最高法院上诉法院提出上诉。
但如果维持四年徒刑，他将无法参加 2030 年举行的下一次选举。
叛国罪是坦桑尼亚最严重的罪行之一，可判处死刑。
人权组织国际特赦组织称他的定罪是“对正义的嘲弄”。
“Tundu Lissu 根本不应该被逮捕，更不用说被起诉和定罪了，”该组织东部和南部非洲区域主任泰格·查古塔 (Tigere Chagutah) 表示
总统萨米亚·苏鲁胡·哈桑 (Samia Suluhu Hassan) 以 98% 的得票率赢得了 2025 年 10 月的选举，反对派认为这一结果是对民主的“嘲弄”，因为包括利苏在内的两名主要挑战者被排除在外。
她的政府一再否认针对其反对者。

title_en: Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats
title_zh: 俄罗斯极端组织否认发送恶作剧炸弹威胁
summary: Scores of flights across Europe have received bomb threats this week, but no explosives have been found so far.
summary_zh: 本周，欧洲各地的数十架航班收到炸弹威胁，但到目前为止尚未发现爆炸物。
body_en: The "Male State", an extremist misogynistic group named in this week's hoax bomb threats to Italian airports, has denied any link to the false warnings causing flight disruption across Europe .

The comments to the BBC came as reports of more bomb scares to airlines began appearing, including on a Ryanair flight from Rome to Lisbon and a Wizz Air flight from Prague to Rome which was diverted to Venice.

Bomb threats were also reported to a number of high-profile Irish media organisations on Friday, prompting evacuations and a statement from the Irish government suggesting a "co-ordinated campaign of disruption".

Replying to the BBC Russian Service, an account on Telegram - one of several linked to the so-called "Male State" and its founder Vladislav Pozdnyakov - mocked any suggestion the group was involved in emailing the threats.

"What Male State? Where have you seen it? It hasn't existed for many years," the message on the channel reads. "If tomorrow they sign a [threat] letter, say, from Putin, will you then try to reach our president to ask your stupid question?"
The group was banned in Russia in 2021 and Pozdnyakov is now thought to live abroad. It has since renamed itself in some places as "Male Legion".
The initial hoax email, seen by the BBC, was sent on Thursday at 07:21 with the subject title: warning of a threat.

It was addressed to several offices and individuals at Aeroporti di Roma (ADR), the airport managing company in Rome, as well as accounts at the city's Fiumicino airport itself. The originating email address seems to be linked to the state health services in Bogota, Colombia.
It's not clear whether other countries' airports or airlines received the same or similar threat. At least one warning made on Friday appears to have come by phone, not email.

Written in word perfect Italian, the bizarre text sent to Rome on Thursday claimed that "fighters" of the "Male State" had planted explosives on two incoming flights in an attack on Italy's "feminist regime" that would be "remembered forever".

One flight was diverted as a result - ordered to land in France – another was escorted into Rome by Italian air force jets, scrambled for the second time this week. No explosives were found on either plane, or any other that reported receiving bomb threats.
Asked why this particular email was taken so seriously, a source at ADR in Rome told the BBC that such warnings were extremely unusual. They didn't remember anything similar in recent years.
Despite the Russian group's denial, Italy's La Stampa newspaper appears in no doubt that "Male State" was behind the threats, asking in an article whether it is acting as "the regime's armed wing".
"Attacking, and being able to deny the attacks...is part of the Russian game plan," the paper writes , external .

One Telegram channel linked to Pozdnyakov is mainly filled with virulently pro-Russian messaging about the war on Ukraine and other posts highlighting problems and tensions in Europe, including recent youth protests.
The online investigation team at Bellingcat, who studied the group back in 2022, called it then a "vocal and vile online booster" of the Russian invasion, with a clear extremist far-right ideology.

As the Europe-wide hunt continues for who is behind the spate of hoax mails, and whether they are being co-ordinated - or could be the work of copycats - Italy's defence minister has warned of a "strategy to increase chaos".
Guido Crosetto noted that he had been talking of the "hybrid threat" to Europe for some years.

"It seems to me that, day after day, from incidents involving refrigerators to the blood supply in France and now these false alarms, there are those who have an interest in fuelling tensions," the minister said on Thursday, referring to a spate of recent cyber attacks that boosted supermarket fridge temperatures, destroying mountains of produce.
"Our interest is to do the opposite and ensure the country's security," Crosetto said.
body_zh: “男性国家”是一个厌恶女性的极端组织，在本周针对意大利机场的恶作剧炸弹威胁中被点名，该组织否认与造成欧洲各地航班中断的虚假警告有任何联系。
英国广播公司发表上述评论之际，正值有关航空公司出现更多炸弹恐慌的报道开始出现，其中包括瑞安航空从罗马飞往里斯本的航班，以及维兹航空从布拉格飞往罗马的航班，该航班改道至威尼斯。
周五，一些备受瞩目的爱尔兰媒体机构也收到了炸弹威胁的报道，促使人们疏散，爱尔兰政府还发表声明，建议开展“协调一致的破坏活动”。
Telegram 上的一个账户（与所谓的“男性国家”及其创始人弗拉迪斯拉夫·波兹德尼亚科夫（Vladislav Pozdnyakov）相关的几个账户之一）在回复 BBC 俄语频道时嘲笑了任何有关该组织参与通过电子邮件发送威胁的说法。
“什么男性国家？你在哪里见过它？它已经很多年不存在了，”频道上的消息写道。 “如果明天他们签署一封来自普京的[威胁]信，你会尝试联系我们的总统问你愚蠢的问题吗？”
该团体于 2021 年在俄罗斯被禁止，目前据信波兹尼亚科夫居住在国外。此后，它在一些地方更名为“男性军团”。
BBC 看到的第一封恶作剧电子邮件于周四 07:21 发送，主题为：威胁警告。
该邮件的收件人是罗马机场管理公司罗马机场 (ADR) 的多个办公室和个人，以及罗马菲乌米奇诺机场的账户。原始电子邮件地址似乎与哥伦比亚波哥大的国家卫生服务机构有关。
目前尚不清楚其他国家的机场或航空公司是否受到相同或类似的威胁。周五发出的至少一个警告似乎是通过电话而不是电子邮件发出的。
周四发往罗马的这份奇怪的文字是用完美的意大利语写成的，声称“男性国家”的“战士”在两架进港航班上安放了炸药，对意大利“女权主义政权”进行了攻击，这将被“永远铭记”。
结果，一架航班改道——被命令降落在法国——另一架飞机则由意大利空军喷气式飞机护送进入罗马，这是本周第二次紧急升空。两架飞机或任何其他报告收到炸弹威胁的飞机上均未发现爆炸物。
当被问及为什么这封特定的电子邮件如此受到重视时，罗马 ADR 的一位消息人士告诉 BBC，此类警告极其不寻常。他们不记得最近几年有过类似的事情。
尽管俄罗斯组织否认，意大利《新闻报》似乎毫无疑问地认为“马累国家”是这些威胁的幕后黑手，并在一篇文章中询问它是否充当“该政权的武装派别”。
“攻击并能够阻止攻击……是俄罗斯游戏计划的一部分，”该报在外部写道。
与波兹德尼亚科夫相关的一个 Telegram 频道主要充斥着有关乌克兰战争的恶毒亲俄信息，以及其他强调欧洲问题和紧张局势的帖子，包括最近的青年抗议活动。
Bellingcat 的在线调查团队早在 2022 年就对该组织进行了研究，称该组织当时是俄罗斯入侵的“高声恶毒的在线支持者”，具有明显的极端主义极右意识形态。
随着欧洲范围内继续追查大量恶作剧邮件的幕后黑手，以及这些邮件是否是相互协调的——或者可能是模仿者所为——意大利国防部长警告说，这是一种“加剧混乱的策略”。
吉多·克罗塞托指出，多年来他一直在谈论欧洲面临的“混合威胁”。
这位部长周四表示：“在我看来，日复一日，从涉及冰箱的事件到法国的血液供应事件，再到现在的这些误报，都有人有意加剧紧张局势。”他指的是最近发生的一系列网络攻击，这些攻击提高了超市冰箱的温度，摧毁了堆积如山的农产品。
克罗塞托说：“我们的利益是反其道而行之，确保国家安全。”

title_en: Paraguay’s Santiago Pena under arrest, new president Pedro Alliana sworn in
title_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳被捕，新总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳宣誓就职
summary: The sudden leadership change comes as Paraguay reels from the collapse of the Ueno Bank, a popular lender.
summary_zh: 领导层突然更迭之际，巴拉圭正因上野银行（一家颇受欢迎的银行）的倒闭而陷入困境。
body_en: Share Paraguay’s Santiago Pena under arrest, new president Pedro Alliana sworn in on social media
Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as the new president of Paraguay, after a banking scandal led to the impeachment of his predecessor, Santiago Pena.
On Friday, Alliana, 52, took the oath of office to become the South American country’s 53rd president.
list of 3 items list 1 of 3 Paraguay resumes Pena impeachment proceedings as financial crisis deepens
list 2 of 3 How Paraguay’s Ueno collapse is only its latest banking crisis
list 3 of 3 Why is Paraguay facing a banking and political crisis?
Previously, Alliana had served as vice president under Pena since the start of the latter’s term in 2023.
But Pena’s tenure came to an abrupt end earlier in the day, after 44 of Paraguay’s senators voted to remove him from office. One senator in the 45-member chamber abstained.
“I take my leave with gratitude, while fully acknowledging the anguish of those who are currently awaiting answers,” Pena wrote on social media on Friday afternoon.

The impeachment marked a rapid fall from power for Pena, a member of the long-governing Colorado Party. His departure coincides this week with the sudden collapse of a prominent lending institution, Ueno Bank.
Questions have arisen about whether the bank was properly regulated by government institutions, and whether Pena himself had conflicts of interest involving the bank.
After Pena’s impeachment, prosecutors ordered him placed under house arrest on suspicion of breach of trust and other crimes.
An arrest warrant was also issued for Carlos Carvallo, the former head of Paraguay’s central bank, which has been accused of failing in its oversight duties. Carvallo resigned earlier this week.

The scandal erupted early on Tuesday, when the central bank announced that Ueno had fallen below the legal standards for solvency, meaning it did not have enough collateral to cover its loans and other ventures.
It seized the lender, transferring its remaining assets to other banking institutions as a safeguard.
Millions of Ueno clients, however, abruptly lost access to their accounts and pension payments as a result of the crisis.
With roughly three million members, the bank counted nearly two-thirds of Paraguay’s adults among its customers.

The company had rocketed to prominence in recent years, consolidating in 2023 under the brand Ueno — sometimes stylised with lowercase letters as “ueno”. It had grown to be Paraguay’s fifth-largest bank by deposits, with $800m in public money fuelling its growth.
Prior to its collapse, Ueno claimed that more than a million Paraguayans had opened their first bank account with the firm.
In 2023, Pena was identified as a shareholder of Ueno’s parent company, though he claimed to have sold his shares in early 2025.
body_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳被捕，新总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳在社交媒体上宣誓就职
佩德罗·阿利亚纳 (Pedro Alliana) 宣誓就任巴拉圭新总统，此前银行业丑闻导致其前任圣地亚哥·佩纳 (Santiago Pena) 被弹劾。
周五，52 岁的阿利亚纳宣誓就职，成为这个南美国家的第 53 任总统。
3 项清单 第 1 项（共 3 项） 随着金融危机加深，巴拉圭恢复佩纳弹劾程序
list 2 of 3 巴拉圭上野的崩溃只是其最新的银行危机
list 3 of 3 为什么巴拉圭面临银行和政治危机？
此前，阿利亚纳自佩纳2023年上任以来一直担任副总统。
但当天早些时候，44 名巴拉圭参议员投票罢免佩纳，他的任期突然结束。 45 名议员中的一名参议员投了弃权票。
佩纳周五下午在社交媒体上写道：“我怀着感激之情离开，同时充分了解那些目前正在等待答案的人们的痛苦。”
这次弹劾标志着长期执政的科罗拉多党成员佩纳迅速下台。本周，他的离职恰逢著名贷款机构上野银行突然倒闭。
人们质疑该银行是否受到政府机构的适当监管，以及佩纳本人是否存在涉及该银行的利益冲突。
佩纳被弹劾后，检察官因涉嫌违反信任和其他罪行而下令将他软禁。
巴拉圭央行前行长卡洛斯·卡瓦洛也被发出逮捕令，该行被指控未能履行监督职责。卡瓦洛本周早些时候辞职。
该丑闻于周二早些时候爆发，当时央行宣布上野的偿付能力已低于法定标准，这意味着该银行没有足够的抵押品来支付其贷款和其他业务。
它查封了贷款人，将剩余资产转移到其他银行机构作为保障。
然而，由于危机，数百万上野客户突然失去了账户和养老金支付的权限。
该银行拥有约 300 万会员，其客户中有近三分之二的巴拉圭成年人。
近年来，该公司声名鹊起，并于 2023 年整合为 Ueno 品牌——有时用小写字母“ueno”来表示。按存款计算，该银行已发展成为巴拉圭第五大银行，8 亿美元的公共资金推动了其增长。
在倒闭之前，上野声称已有超过一百万巴拉圭人在该公司开设了第一个银行账户。
2023 年，佩纳被确认为上野母公司的股东，尽管他声称已在 2025 年初出售了自己的股份。

title_en: Low pressure in US midwest brings unseasonable heat to New York and Boston
title_zh: 美国中西部低压给纽约和波士顿带来不合时宜的炎热天气
summary: Further south this week, severe thunderstorms affected midterms voting in Florida, Oklahoma and Colorado Despite the rapid descent into autumn in the northern hemisphere, parts of eastern North America have experienced an exceptionally late taste of summer in
summary_zh: 本周，在更南边，严重的雷暴影响了佛罗里达州、俄克拉荷马州和科罗拉多州的中期选举，尽管气温迅速下降到秋季。
body_en: Further south this week, severe thunderstorms affected midterms voting in Florida, Oklahoma and Colorado

Despite the rapid descent into autumn in the northern hemisphere, parts of eastern North America have experienced an exceptionally late taste of summer in recent days. Temperatures approached 23C (73F) in New York and Boston, about 7-10C above what is expected in early November. The unseasonable warmth spilled into parts of eastern Canada, with temperatures exceeding 20C, about 10-15C above normal for the time of year. The balmy conditions were caused by an area of low pressure in the US midwest, dragging up exceptionally warm air from the Gulf of Mexico along its eastern flank. This area of low pressure will gradually drift eastwards, allowing temperatures to fall closer to the average.

Further south, severe thunderstorms have resulted in numerous flood warnings and evacuation warnings being issued this week across many states, with disruptive weather affecting polling stations in Florida, Oklahoma and Colorado. The powerful thunderstorms even resulted in a tornado touching down in Keyes, Oklahoma, forcing the relocation of a polling station. The tornado caused extensive damage, although no causalities have been reported. Officials across many states have requested federal funding assistance after the extreme weather resulted in widespread damage to homes and infrastructure.
body_zh: 本周更南边，严重雷暴影响了佛罗里达州、俄克拉荷马州和科罗拉多州的中期选举

尽管北半球迅速入秋，但北美东部部分地区最近几天却经历了异常迟来的夏季。纽约和波士顿的气温接近 23 摄氏度（73 华氏度），比 11 月初的预期高出约 7 至 10 摄氏度。反常的高温蔓延到加拿大东部部分地区，气温超过 20 摄氏度，比常年同期高出约 10 至 15 摄氏度。气候温和的天气是由美国中西部的一个低压区造成的，该低压区从墨西哥湾沿其东侧吹来异常温暖的空气。该低压区域将逐渐向东漂移，使气温接近平均水平。
再往南，严重雷暴导致许多州本周发布了多次洪水警告和疏散警告，破坏性天气影响了佛罗里达州、俄克拉荷马州和科罗拉多州的投票站。强大的雷暴甚至导致龙卷风袭击俄克拉荷马州凯斯，迫使投票站搬迁。龙卷风造成了广泛的破坏，但尚未报告人员伤亡。在极端天气对房屋和基础设施造成大范围破坏后，许多州的官员已请求联邦资金援助。

title_en: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克似乎预示着赛博卡车之路的终结
summary: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.
summary_zh: 马斯克表示，这是为了为其生产 Cyber​​cabs（没有司机的自动出租车）腾出空间。
body_en: Tesla will wind down production of its Cybertruck vehicles at its Texas factory next year, Elon Musk says.
He did not spell out whether it plans to stop making them entirely or shift production elsewhere, but did say the decision was to "make room" for building more of its self-driving Cybercab cars.

But the project's lead engineer, Wes Morrill, appeared to suggest the vehicle was being discontinued, writing on X: "Cybertruck was an incredible technology development platform and lives on through Cybercab."
With its distinctive angular looks, the Cybertruck attracted diehard fans, but was beset by delays before being launched in 2023 and has had disappointing sales numbers since.
Tesla fans have been mourning the news online, with one person calling it " the best vehicle Tesla has ever made , external " as he lamented it being "discontinued next year".
Musk responded to the user , external with the word "true", adding: "But the Cybertruck fleet will be around for a long time."
Tesla's stock rose 4.7% on Friday after his announcement.

The vehicle has always been a passion project for Musk. He said it was " way more awesome than people realise , external " in March, and called it the " best product Tesla has ever made to date , external " in April.
But there have always been big questions about whether consumers shared that view and whether the Cybertruck could cut through and earn a spot in the US' lucrative truck market.
It was not helped by inauspicious introduction to the public in 2019 when Musk attempted to show off the Cybertruck's apparently unbreakable glass, only for it to shatter during a live demonstration.
Despite the gaffe, the Cybertruck ended up receiving a 146,000 orders, Musk said in 2019 , while it was still in development.
In the end, the vehicle launched in 2023, keeping its novel design - an angular shape with a body made of stainless steel.
In 2025, Tesla sold just 20,237 Cybertrucks, a decline from 38,965 a year earlier, according to figures from Kelley Blue Book.
Musk had predicted annual sales of 250,000 after commercial production of Cybertruck began in 2023.
Tesla fans praised its retro-futuristic look, which some said looked like something " straight out of Blade Runner , external ".
But critics were far less kind, joking about its appearance and labelling it " ugly as sin , external ".
Several recalls - including in 2025 affecting more than 46,000 Cybertrucks over concerns part of its trim could fall off - would not have helped.
"We need to make it at a price that people can afford," Musk told Wall Street analysts that year - which ended up being $61,000 (then £48,000) for all the "bells and whistles".
In 2026, the so-called "Cyberbeast" model comes in at $102,000.
body_zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，特斯拉明年将减少其德克萨斯州工厂的 Cyber​​truck 车辆生产。
他没有具体说明是否计划完全停止生产或将生产转移到其他地方，但他确实表示，这一决定是为了“腾出空间”来建造更多的自动驾驶 Cyber​​cab 汽车。
但该项目的首席工程师 Wes Morrill 似乎暗示该车辆将被停产，他在 X 上写道：“Cyber​​truck 是一个令人难以置信的技术开发平台，并通过 Cyber​​cab 继续存在。”
Cyber​​truck 凭借其独特的棱角外观吸引了铁杆粉丝，但在 2023 年推出之前就受到了延误的困扰，此后的销售数据令人失望。
特斯拉粉丝一直在网上哀悼这一消息，有人称其为“特斯拉有史以来制造的最好的外部汽车”，并感叹该车“明年将停产”。
马斯克对外用“真实”一词回应了该用户，并补充道：“但 Cyber​​truck 车队将存在很长一段时间。”
在他宣布这一消息后，特斯拉股价周五上涨 4.7%。
这辆车一直是马斯克热衷的项目。他在三月份表示，它“比人们想象的要棒得多，外部”，并在四月份称其为“特斯拉迄今为止制造的最好的产品，外部”。
但消费者是否认同这种观点，以及 Cyber​​truck 能否在美国利润丰厚的卡车市场中脱颖而出并赢得一席之地，一直存在很大的疑问。
2019 年，马斯克试图向公众展示 Cyber​​truck 看似牢不可破的玻璃，结果在现场演示中玻璃碎裂，这对公众的介绍并没有起到什么作用。
马斯克在 2019 年表示，尽管出现了失误，但 Cyber​​truck 仍处于开发阶段，最终还是收到了 146,000 份订单。
最终，该车于 2023 年推出，保持了其新颖的设计——棱角分明的造型，车身由不锈钢制成。
根据凯利蓝皮书的数据，2025 年，特斯拉仅售出了 20,237 辆赛博卡车，比一年前的 38,965 辆有所下降。
马斯克曾预计，2023年Cyber​​truck开始商业化生产后，年销量将达到25万辆。
特斯拉粉丝称赞其复古未来主义外观，有人说它看起来“直接来自银翼杀手，外部”。
但批评者却远没有那么友善，他们拿它的外观开玩笑，并给它贴上“丑陋如罪恶、外在的”标签。
数次召回——包括 2025 年因担心部分内饰可能脱落而影响超过 46,000 辆 Cyber​​truck 的召回——也于事无补。
“我们需要以人们能够承受的价格来生产，”马斯克当年对华尔街分析师说，所有“花里胡哨”的价格最终为 61,000 美元（当时为 48,000 英镑）。
2026 年，所谓的“Cyber​​beast”型号的售价为 102,000 美元。

title_en: Global stocks fall amid ‘big worries over AI’ after Democrats’ midterms triumph
title_zh: 民主党中期选举获胜后，全球股市因“对人工智能的巨大担忧”而下跌
summary: Asian and European markets follow US tech rout with many analysts predicting more waves of selling to come European and Asian stock markets fell sharply on Friday after the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterms triggered a rout in US tech stocks a day ea
summary_zh: 亚洲和欧洲市场追随美国科技股溃败，许多分析师预测未来将出现更多抛售潮 欧洲和亚洲股市大幅下跌
body_en: European and Asian stock markets fell sharply on Friday after the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterms triggered a rout in US tech stocks a day earlier.

A sell-off on Wall Street on Thursday was followed by sharp falls in Asian stock markets on Friday. The investor sentiment then reached London, where the market was, at one stage, poised for its worst day since March.

The FTSE 100 index, which tracks blue-chip shares listed in London, was down as much as 254 points, or 2.35%, at 10,528 points during a wave of selling in morning trading. But by the close of the day it had clawed back some of its losses to be down 1%, helped by a rise in US stocks when Wall Street reopened.
Germany’s Dax index fell by 2%, France’s Cac 40 dropped by 0.8% and Spain’s Ibex lost 0.6%.

Susannah Streeter, the chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, said: “The tech sell-off has intensified, with the pain of the brutal sell-off on Wall Street carried straight through to Asia and knocking sentiment in Europe .

“Big worries are colliding – the build-out of datacentres looks set to slow, which risks shredding the spending spree underpinning the boom, right at the time that investors have become super nervous about returns on this massive investment.”

However, there were signs of easing jitters on Wall Street on Friday, where tech stocks rose, lifting the S&P 500 share index by 0.3% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq closed up 1% – which only recovered a portion of their previous day’s losses.
That followed a stronger-than-expected employment report that showed the US economy added 165,000 new jobs in October, pulling the unemployment rate down to 4.1%.
On Thursday, the Nasdaq share index had its worst day in 19 months after slumping 5.5%.

Chip stocks led the slump on Thursday, with the memory maker SanDisk tumbling by 22% and the hard drive maker Western Digital falling by 17%. Wall Street’s “fear index”, the Vix, jumped by more than 60% to its highest levels since the early weeks of the Iran war, in a sign of rising market volatility.
The heavy falls continued in Asia on Friday, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 index sinking 6% and South Korea’s Kospi index tumbling more than 6.5%.
“It’s actually a bit of a disaster,” said Christopher Forbes, the head of Asia and Middle East at CMC Markets.

“[Clients] were long index, long stocks, and they all got carried out. All night, all day – we had client margin calls, client complaints … because it’s a very emotional thing, right? People are wedded to their positions and views on a stock or outcome, and you’re telling them: ‘Look, you’ve just lost money.’”

Chris Beauchamp, the chief market analyst at the investing and trading platform IG, said: “Yesterday’s [Thursday’s] brutal session marked a dramatic turnaround from Wednesday, but with AI fears still prominent there is a risk that there is much more selling to come.

“Investors remain on watch for a potential resumption of the Iran conflict, and are nervously watching the oil price after its slump earlier in the week. All in all it remains a very febrile atmosphere.”

However, despite the sharp losses suffered on global stock markets around the world, most indices are still up for the year. The Nasdaq Composite index remains up 6.35% since the start of January – even though it is more than 10% below its peak.
The FTSE 100 has gained almost 7.5% in 2026 – but it is now more than 300 points below the record high set in July.

Mohit Kumar, an economist at the investment bank Jefferies, said that while he did not expect a quick rebound from Thursday’s losses in the US, he also did not believe it marked the “start of the unwind of the AI trade”.

He said: “AI investment has been a key driver of US growth and we do not see the Democrats as giving up on this growth engine. Datacentres and AI infrastructure also create jobs and Democrats would be reluctant to let those jobs move on to other states or outside the country.”
body_zh: 民主党在中期选举中取得决定性胜利，引发美国科技股前一天暴跌，欧洲和亚洲股市周五大幅下跌。
周四华尔街遭遇抛售，周五亚洲股市大幅下跌。随后，投资者情绪传至伦敦，伦敦市场一度面临自 3 月份以来最糟糕的一天。
追踪在伦敦上市的蓝筹股的富时 100 指数在早盘交易中一波抛售潮中下跌 254 点，跌幅为 2.35%，至 10,528 点。但到当天收盘时，在华尔街重新开市后美国股市上涨的帮助下，该公司已收复部分失地，跌幅为 1%。
德国Dax指数下跌2%，法国Cac 40指数下跌0.8%，西班牙Ibex指数下跌0.6%。
Wealth Club 首席投资策略师苏珊娜·斯特里特 (Susannah Streeter) 表示：“科技股抛售加剧，华尔街惨遭抛售的痛苦直接波及亚洲，打击欧洲情绪。
“巨大的担忧正在相互冲突——数据中心的建设似乎将放缓，这可能会粉碎支撑经济繁荣的支出热潮，而此时投资者已经对这项大规模投资的回报变得超级紧张。”
不过，周五华尔街的紧张情绪有缓解的迹象，科技股上涨，带动标普 500 指数上涨 0.3%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数收涨 1%，仅收复前一日的部分跌幅。
此前公布的就业报告强于预期，显示美国 10 月份新增就业岗位 16.5 万个，失业率降至 4.1%。
周四，纳斯达克股票指数暴跌 5.5%，创下 19 个月来最糟糕的一天。
芯片股周四领跌，内存制造商 SanDisk 下跌 22%，硬盘制造商 Western Digital 下跌 17%。华尔街的“恐惧指数”Vix 飙升超过 60%，达到伊朗战争最初几周以来的最高水平，这表明市场波动性加剧。
周五亚洲股市继续大幅下跌，日本日经225指数下跌6%，韩国Kospi指数下跌超过6.5%。
CMC Markets 亚洲和中东地区主管克里斯托弗·福布斯 (Christopher Forbes) 表示：“这实际上有点灾难。”
“[客户]做多指数、做多股票，但他们都被套现了。整夜、一整天——我们都有客户追加保证金、客户投诉……因为这是一件非常情绪化的事情，对吧？人们执着于自己的头寸和对股票或结果的看法，而你告诉他们：‘看，你刚刚赔了钱。’”
投资和交易平台 IG 的首席市场分析师 Chris Beauchamp 表示：“昨天（周四）的残酷交易标志着周三的戏剧性转变，但由于对人工智能的担忧仍然突出，未来可能会出现更多抛售。”
“投资者仍在关注伊朗冲突可能卷土重来的情况，并在本周早些时候暴跌后紧张地关注油价。总而言之，气氛仍然非常热烈。”
然而，尽管全球股市大幅下跌，但今年以来大多数指数仍然上涨。自 1 月初以来，纳斯达克综合指数仍上涨 6.35%，尽管较峰值低了 10% 以上。
2026 年，富时 100 指数上涨了近 7.5%，但目前仍比 7 月份创下的历史高点低了 300 多点。
投资银行杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 经济学家莫希特·库马尔 (Mohit Kumar) 表示，虽然他预计美国股市不会从周四的跌幅中迅速反弹，但他也不认为这标志着“人工智能交易开始平仓”。
他表示：“人工智能投资一直是美国经济增长的关键驱动力，我们认为民主党不会放弃这一增长引擎。数据中心和人工智能基础设施也会创造就业机会，民主党人不愿意让这些就业机会转移到其他州或国外。”

title_en: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
title_zh: 市值蒸发数万亿美元后，人工智能股票攀升
summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
summary_zh: 投资者一直在抛售科技股，部分原因是担心民主党选举胜利将意味着人工智能发展放缓。
body_en: Shares in artificial intelligence and technology firms have recovered slightly from an enormous sell-off that wiped trillions of dollars off stock values.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index closed in positive territory following a market rout that began in the US on Thursday before spilling over to Asian and European markets into Friday.
Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development.
However the latest US employment figures added to a mixed picture for American markets on Friday morning, with an unexpectedly strong 165,000 jobs added to the economy in September.
On Thursday, businesses closely linked to artificial intelligence development took a hammering on stock markets, particularly chip and semiconductor makers.
But the Nasdaq Composite bounced back slightly on Friday, ending the day up 1.1%, partly reversing some of its 5.5% fall.

The S&P 500, which tracks the share prices of the largest publicly-traded US companies, closed up 0.3%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average was flat through the day before ending slightly down 0.4%.
Companies that lost hundreds of billions in market value recovered some ground on Friday, including Nvidia, SpaceX and Tesla.
However, stock markets in Asia and Europe fared worse.

The Kospi in South Korea closed down 6% on Friday, with shares in chipmaker SK Hynix plunging more than 10%. European markets also fell, with the main indexes in Germany, France and Spain ending the day down.
In the UK, the FTSE 100, which tracks the largest companies on the London Stock Exchange, declined 1.01%.

In addition to the recent market volatility, UK traders were also digesting the latest Bank of England decision to raise interest rates and the signal that another rate rise could be on the cards to curb rising prices.
The market fluctuations also come after the sweeping Democrat victory in the midterm elections.

A number of Democrats campaigned for new rules and regulations for artificial intelligence (AI) and data centres, and the party has since won control of both houses of congress as well as key contests in states that have been part of the AI data centre race.
US President Donald Trump on Friday reiterated his supported for what he calls "super intelligence", saying only "foolish leadership" would "say no to the riches they bring".
However, there have also been concerns over whether the enormous amounts of money being spent on AI will pay off.
Russ Shaw, founder of global tech advocacy firm Tech London Advocates, said the election result was sending a message that a rethink was needed on AI.
"The incoming Congress is going to really focus on AI in a very dramatic way," he told the BBC's Business Today.
"I'm a big fan of AI, but I'm watching what these companies are doing, and they're not communicating effectively at all, particularly in the US, about what the benefits of AI are all about."

Pierre Baqué, chief executive of AI platform Neural Concept, said the share movements were a "necessary market correction" that reflected a legitimate concern about the amount of money being poured into AI infrastructure.
body_zh: 人工智能和科技公司的股票已从巨大的抛售中小幅回升，抛售使股价蒸发了数万亿美元。
以科技股为主的纳斯达克股指收盘上涨，周四美国市场开始暴跌，周五蔓延至亚洲和欧洲市场。
投资者一直在抛售科技股，部分原因是担心民主党在中期选举中获胜将意味着人工智能发展放缓。
然而，最新的美国就业数据令周五上午的美国市场好坏参半，9 月份经济新增就业岗位 165,000 个，出人意料地强劲。
周四，与人工智能开发密切相关的企业，特别是芯片和半导体制造商的股市遭受重创。
但纳斯达克综合指数周五小幅反弹，收盘上涨 1.1%，部分扭转了 5.5% 的跌幅。
追踪美国最大上市公司股价的标准普尔 500 指数收盘上涨 0.3%，而道琼斯工业平均指数全天持平，收盘小幅下跌 0.4%。
周五，市值损失数千亿美元的公司收复了一些失地，其中包括英伟达、SpaceX 和特斯拉。
然而，亚洲和欧洲股市表现较差。
韩国综合指数周五收盘下跌 6%，芯片制造商 SK 海力士股价暴跌超过 10%。欧洲股市也下跌，德国、法国和西班牙主要股指收盘下跌。
在英国，跟踪伦敦证券交易所最大公司的富时 100 指数下跌 1.01%。
除了近期的市场波动外，英国交易员也在消化英国央行最新的加息决定以及可能再次加息以抑制物价上涨的信号。
市场波动也是在民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利之后出现的。
许多民主党人为人工智能（AI）和数据中心制定新的规则和法规而竞选，该党此后赢得了国会两院的控制权，以及参与人工智能数据中心竞赛的各州的关键竞选。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五重申了他对他所谓的“超级智慧”的支持，并表示只有“愚蠢的领导”才会“对他们带来的财富说不”。
然而，人们也担心在人工智能上投入的巨额资金是否会得到回报。
全球科技倡导公司 Tech London Advocates 的创始人 Russ Shaw 表示，选举结果传递出一个信息，即需要重新思考人工智能。
他对 BBC 的《今日商业》表示：“即将召开的国会将以一种非常戏剧性的方式真正关注人工智能。”
“我是人工智能的忠实粉丝，但我正在观察这些公司在做什么，但他们根本没有有效地沟通人工智能的好处，特别是在美国。”
人工智能平台 Neural Concept 首席执行官皮埃尔·巴克 (Pierre Baqué) 表示，股价波动是“必要的市场调整”，反映了对投入人工智能基础设施的资金数量的合理担忧。

title_en: Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam
title_zh: 抗议者闯入阿姆斯特丹的微软数据中心
summary: Data centres face protests across Europe due to the massive amounts of computing power and water they use.
summary_zh: 由于使用大量的计算能力和水，数据中心在欧洲各地面临抗议。
body_en: Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam | Protests News | Al Jazeera
Share Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam on social media
Protesters in the Netherlands have broken into a construction site for a new Microsoft data centre in Amsterdam, the latest action in a growing movement sweeping Europe.

Several hundred activists occupied the site in the Sloterdijk district on Friday, responding to a call for a two-day protest across Europe against data centres, which handle the large processing workloads associated with artificial intelligence (AI). Demonstrators clashed with police as some climbed a crane and set off flares.

Nathan Timmer, of the protest group Geef Tegengas – which translates as Push Back – told local broadcaster AT5 that demonstrators were occupying the site in an effort to stop construction.
“We don’t want it to be built. Nobody needs it,” Timmer said. “The only thing this will be used for is AI slop. AI warfare, data surveillance and committing genocide. We don’t want that.”
Pro-Palestinian activists also joined the demonstrations in the Dutch capital. By late afternoon police were escorting activists off the construction site, though some remained, local media reported.
Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people suspected of trespassing during the protest.
Microsoft said it was aware of the Amsterdam demonstration.

“We understand that people feel strongly about the project, and we respect their right to express those views peacefully,” a spokesperson said. “However, we do not condone any actions that are unlawful or that put people’s safety at risk.”

Data centres face resistance around the world due to the massive amounts of computing power and water they use. Activists argue that the boom in facilities serving cloud computing and AI is moving faster than public consultation and environmental oversight.

Dozens of civil society and grassroots groups have said they will join the “Stop Dirty Data Centres” events on Friday and Saturday in 15 European countries, including Ireland, Poland, Denmark, Finland, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, France and the United Kingdom, organisers said.
In Germany, a dozen protesters gathered in front of a data centre on the outskirts of Berlin on Friday.

“We want to put a stop to this blind construction of data centres around Germany, regardless of any environmental concerns,” said protest spokeswoman Caro Weber. “This is really, really dangerous for our future.”
About 100 people also protested against data centres in front of the Polish parliament, representing communities around Warsaw where new centres are planned.

In Italy, the fast-growing data centre industry is facing an equally rapid rise in grassroots opposition, particularly in the northern Lombardy region, the country’s main hub for digital infrastructure.

“我们不想建造它。没有人需要它，”蒂默说。 “它唯一的用途就是人工智能垃圾。人工智能战争、数据监视和种族灭绝。我们不希望这样。”

一位发言人表示：“我们理解人们对该项目的强烈感受，我们尊重他们和平表达这些观点的权利。” “但是，我们不会容忍任何非法或危及人民安全的行为。”
由于使用大量的计算能力和水，数据中心在世界各地都面临阻力。活动人士认为，服务于云计算和人工智能的设施的繁荣发展速度快于公众咨询和环境监督。
组织者称，数十个民间社会和草根团体表示，他们将参加周五和周六在爱尔兰、波兰、丹麦、芬兰、西班牙、意大利、荷兰、法国和英国等 15 个欧洲国家举行的“停止肮脏数据中心”活动。
在德国，周五，十几名抗议者聚集在柏林郊区的一个数据中心前。

大约 100 人还在波兰议会前抗议数据中心，他们代表华沙周围计划建立新数据中心的社区。
在意大利，快速增长的数据中心行业也面临着同样快速增长的草根反对声音，特别是在该国数字基础设施的主要枢纽伦巴第北部地区。

title_en: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis
title_zh: 上野银行丑闻使巴拉圭陷入政治危机
summary: Suspected financial fraud, public money at risk and millions of customers affected: Paraguay is in serious crisis following the sudden collapse of Ueno Bank. President Santiago Pena is facing impeachment.
summary_zh: 涉嫌金融欺诈，公共资金面临风险，数百万客户受到影响：Uen突然倒闭后，巴拉圭陷入严重危机
body_en: The Ueno Bank collapse is turning into one of the biggest financial and political scandals in the history of Paraguay . At issue are suspected banking irregularities, hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds, and business ties between the bank and the country's president, Santiago Pena.

The crisis was triggered on November 3, when the Paraguayan central bank (BCP) initiated resolution procedures against Ueno after determining that it had breached minimum solvency requirements. The public prosecutor has since announced three investigations into suspected financial crimes. 27 individuals have already been formally charged.

Pressure on President Pena intensified. On November 5, he tendered his resignation , but the Paraguayan Congress did not accept it. Instead, the Chamber of Deputies voted unanimously to impeach him. A joint session of both legislative chambers was called to consider the resignation, but the session was not quorate, so no decision could be taken. Pena remains in office for now, and the Senate has opened impeachment proceedings.

Ueno Bank is a Paraguayan digital bank belonging to the Grupo Vazquez, a big Paraguayan conglomerate. Launched in 2021, it expanded remarkably fast: It recently had around three million customers, almost half the population of Paraguay. At the same time, there were warnings that the bank might have extended excessive loans to companies associated with its owners.

On November 3, 2026, the Paraguayan Central Bank (BCP) intervened, having determined that the bank had breached minimum solvency requirements: It no longer had sufficient capital to provide security for risks it had incurred. Business operations were abruptly suspended, leaving millions of customers unable to access their accounts.
Investigations are primarily focused on three potential problems.
First, Ueno Bank is believed to have extended credit to other companies from the same group, and these may have exceeded legal limits.
Some business dealings may also have served to conceal the lack of capital, and make the bank's financial situation appear better than it actually was.
There is also the question of why the Central Bank didn't intervene sooner, despite indications that there were problems.
How much public money is managed by Ueno Bank?

Ueno Bank held huge deposits of public money. Its most important investors include the Instituto de Prevision Social (IPS), the Paraguayan social security agency responsible for pensions and social welfare payments. According to media reports, Ueno Bank administers public funds totalling as much as 800 to 850 million US dollars.

Not only is the size of the amount problematic, so is the concentration of public funds in a single financial institution — one that has had to be placed under state control. Other state institutions are also said to have continued to deposit funds with the bank.
This raises questions about how state institutions make their investment decisions, and the risks to which they have exposed public funds.
What are the bank's connections to Santiago Pena?

There is Pena's business relationship with Grupo Vazquez, to which the Ueno Bank belongs. The Paraguayan president maintained business connections with the conglomerate until March 2025, long after his election as head of state. However, he denies having had any direct involvement with the bank.

On the other hand, Pena's appointment of Carlos Carvallo as president of the Central Bank in 2023 has come under scrutiny. The decision is controversial because until then Carvallo was the chair of the finance company that became Ueno Bank, Financiero Ueno. It raises questions about possible conflict of interest, and the independence of banking supervision.
Carvallo resigned on November 3, at Pena's request.
On November 4, the public prosecutor's office formally charged 27 people: eight Ueno Bank executives, and 19 others with connections to companies associated with the bank.
The investigations are looking into suspected breach of trust, attempted fraud, breach of duty in crisis situations, and violation of the legal obligation to keep records.

On November 5, a judge remanded several former bank executives in custody, including Federico Miguel Vazquez Villasanti, the president of Grupo Vazquez. Two other accused were placed under house arrest.
body_zh: 上野银行倒闭正在成为巴拉圭历史上最大的金融和政治丑闻之一。问题包括涉嫌银行业违规行为、数亿美元的公共资金以及该银行与该国总统圣地亚哥·佩纳之间的商业关系。
此次危机于 11 月 3 日引发，当时巴拉圭中央银行 (BCP) 在确定 Ueno 违反了最低偿付能力要求后启动了针对 Ueno 的解决程序。此后，检察官宣布对涉嫌金融犯罪进行三项调查。已有 27 人受到正式指控。
佩纳总统面临的压力越来越大。 11月5日，他提出辞呈，但巴拉圭国会没有接受。相反，众议院一致投票弹劾他。两院联席会议被召集审议辞职，但会议未达到法定人数，因此无法做出决定。佩纳目前仍留任，参议院已启动弹劾程序。
Ueno Bank 是一家巴拉圭数字银行，隶属于巴拉圭大型企业集团 Grupo Vazquez。该公司于 2021 年推出，扩张速度非常快：最近拥有约 300 万客户，几乎相当于巴拉圭人口的一半。与此同时，有人警告称，该银行可能向与其所有者相关的公司提供了过多的贷款。
2026 年 11 月 3 日，巴拉圭中央银行 (BCP) 进行干预，认定该银行违反了最低偿付能力要求：它不再有足够的资本为其所发生的风险提供担保。业务运营突然暂停，导致数百万客户无法访问他们的帐户。
调查主要集中在三个潜在问题。
首先，据信上野银行向同一集团的其他公司提供了信贷，这些信贷可能已经超出了法定限额。
一些业务往来也可能掩盖了资本的缺乏，使银行的财务状况看起来比实际情况要好。
还有一个问题是，尽管有迹象表明存在问题，但央行为何不尽早干预。
上野银行管理着多少公共资金？
上野银行持有大量公款存款。其最重要的投资者包括负责养老金和社会福利支付的巴拉圭社会保障机构Instituto de Prevision Social (IPS)。据媒体报道，上野银行管理的公共资金总额高达800至8.5亿美元。
不仅数额大小存在问题，而且公共资金集中在单一金融机构中也存在问题——该机构必须置于国家控制之下。据说其他国家机构也继续在该银行存入资金。
这引发了关于国家机构如何做出投资决策以及它们使公共资金面临的风险的问题。
该银行与圣地亚哥佩纳有什么关系？
Pena 与上野银行所属的 Grupo Vazquez 存在业务关系。这位巴拉圭总统在 2025 年 3 月之前一直与该集团保持业务联系，此时距他当选国家元首很久之后。不过，他否认与该银行有任何直接参与。
另一方面，佩纳任命卡洛斯·卡瓦洛于2023年担任央行行长也受到密切关注。这一决定颇具争议，因为在此之前卡瓦洛一直担任上野银行金融公司 Financiero Ueno 的董事长。它引发了有关可能的利益冲突和银行监管独立性的问题。
应佩纳的要求，卡瓦洛于 11 月 3 日辞职。
11 月 4 日，检察机关正式对 27 人提出指控，其中包括 8 名上野银行高管和 19 名与该银行相关公司有联系的人。
调查正在调查涉嫌违反信任、企图欺诈、危机情况下失职以及违反保存记录的法律义务的行为。
11 月 5 日，法官将几名前银行高管还押，其中包括巴斯克斯集团总裁费德里科·米格尔·巴斯克斯·维拉桑蒂 (Federico Miguel Vazquez Villasanti)。另外两名被告被软禁。

summary_zh: 这位智利电影制作人在圣地亚哥的家中去世，其电影由弗洛伦斯·皮尤 (Florence Pugh)、朱丽安·摩尔 (Julianne Moore) 和蕾切尔·薇兹 (Rachel Weisz) 主演。
body_en: The Chilean film-maker, whose films starred Florence Pugh, Julianne Moore and Rachel Weisz, died at his home in Santiago
Chilean film-maker Sebastián Lelio has died at the age of 52.
He was best known for the Oscar-winning trans drama A Fantastic Woman and his English-language films included Gloria Bell and The Wonder.

His partner Amalia Kassai announced his death on Instagram without specifying the cause of death but telling followers, in Spanish, that it was a painful time for his family. Chilean media reports that he died at his home in Las Condes, Santiago.
Director Sebastián Lelio: ‘The presence of porn is everywhere and making us numb’

Lelio was born in Argentina but moved to Chile at the age of two. He studied journalism for one year before graduating from film school and then released 9/11 documentary Cero in 2003. His first narrative film The Sacred Family premiered at the San Sebastián film festival in 2005.

His follow-up, 2009’s Christmas, premiered at Cannes but it was 2013’s Gloria that provided him with a major international breakthrough. The drama, about a woman in her late 50s who starts dating again, premiered at Berlin and won its lead star Paulina García an acting award at the festival.

Lelio followed it up with A Fantastic Woman, a drama about the life of a trans woman, another breakout that became the first Chilean film to win the Oscar for best international feature. In a five-star review, the Guardian’s Peter Bradshaw called it “a sublime study in the exalted ordeal of grief”.

“When we released it in 2017, a gender identity bill had been dormant in congress for seven years,” he said in a Guardian interview in 2018. “Somehow, the film’s release, and the year in which it became globally known, helped to reactivate the discussion in Chile.”

He made his English language debut with London-set drama Disobedience which told a queer love story between women played by Rachel Weisz and Rachel McAdams . It was nominated for five British independent film awards.

Lelio then remade Gloria as Gloria Bell, then set in America and starring Julianne Moore in the lead role. He followed it with a critically acclaimed adaptation of Emma Donoghue’s novel The Wonder starring Florence Pugh.

“I love working with actors, and need to know they trust me and can explore, get lost, be foolish or brave, and I’ll take care of them,” he said to the Guardian. “I love working on set – it is where the sparkle is.”
His final film was 2025’s The Wave, a musical protest drama that premiered at Cannes.
“Making a film is like a gift you leave somewhere – you then hide and see what happens,” he said.
body_zh: 这位智利电影制片人在圣地亚哥的家中去世，他的电影由弗洛伦斯·皮尤、朱丽安·摩尔和蕾切尔·薇兹主演。
智利电影制片人塞巴斯蒂安·莱里奥去世，享年 52 岁。
他因获得奥斯卡奖的跨性别剧情片《神奇女人》而闻名，他的英语电影包括《格洛丽亚·贝尔》和《奇迹》。
他的伴侣阿玛莉亚·卡赛 (Amalia Kassai) 在 Instagram 上宣布了他的死讯，但没有具体说明死因，但用西班牙语告诉粉丝，这对他的家人来说是一段痛苦的时光。智利媒体报道称，他在圣地亚哥拉斯孔德斯的家中去世。
导演塞巴斯蒂安·莱利奥：“色情内容无处不在，让我们麻木”
莱里奥出生于阿根廷，两岁时移居智利。他在电影学校毕业前学习了一年新闻学，并于 2003 年发行了 9/11 纪录片《Cero》。他的第一部叙事电影《神圣家族》于 2005 年在圣塞巴斯蒂安电影节首映。
他的后续影片 2009 年的《圣诞节》在戛纳首映，但 2013 年的《格洛丽亚》为他带来了国际上的重大突破。该剧讲述了一位 50 多岁的女性再次开始约会的故事，该剧在柏林首映，并为主演宝琳娜·加西亚赢得了电影节表演奖。
莱里奥紧接着推出了一部关于跨性别女性生活的剧情片《神奇女人》，这是另一部突破性作品，成为第一部获得奥斯卡最佳国际影片奖的智利电影。 《卫报》的彼得·布拉德肖 (Peter Bradshaw) 在五星级评论中称其为“对悲伤的崇高磨难的一项崇高研究”。
他在 2018 年接受《卫报》采访时表示：“当我们在 2017 年上映这部电影时，一项性别认同法案已在国会沉寂了七年。不知何故，这部电影的上映以及它在全球广为人知的那一年，帮助重新激活了智利的讨论。”
他的英语处女作是在伦敦拍摄的剧情片《Disobedience》，讲述了由蕾切尔·薇兹 (Rachel Weisz) 和蕾切尔·麦克亚当斯 (Rachel McAdams) 饰演的女性之间的酷爱故事。它获得五项英国独立电影奖提名。
莱利奥随后将格洛丽亚改名为格洛丽亚·贝尔，故事背景设定在美国，由朱丽安·摩尔主演。随后，他改编自艾玛·多诺霍的小说《奇迹》，由弗洛伦斯·皮尤主演，广受好评。
“我喜欢与演员一起工作，需要知道他们信任我，可以探索、迷失、愚蠢或勇敢，我会照顾他们，”他对卫报说。 “我喜欢在片场工作——那里才是闪光点。”
他的最后一部电影是 2025 年的《浪潮》，一部在戛纳首映的音乐抗议剧。
“拍电影就像你留在某个地方的一份礼物——然后你躲起来看看会发生什么，”他说。

title_en: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
title_zh: 教皇利奥在接受癌症手术后开始了为期 12 天、南美洲 3 个国家的访问
summary: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.
summary_zh: 教皇利奥开始了肺癌手术后的首次南美之旅。 12天的旅程，他去了乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁，在那里度过了12天的旅程。
body_en: Pope Leo XIV's South American homecoming: Uruguay, Argentina and Peru : NPR

Pope Leo XIV's South American homecoming: Uruguay, Argentina and Peru Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.
Pope Leo XIV waves after meeting with Uruguay's President Yamandu Orsi at Plaza Independencia in Montevideo, Uruguay, Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. Matilde Campodonico

MONTEVIDEO, Uruguay — Pope Leo XIV has arrived in South America for a 12-day, three-country journey that will be his longest and most far-reaching trip yet, and his first major overseas visit since undergoing lung cancer surgery.

Along the way Leo will take 12 flights, including two helicopter rides, give 36 speeches and visit 10 cities including Cusco, Peru, which sits more than 11,000 feet above sea level. Even the heartiest of travelers can experience altitude sickness there and may require supplemental oxygen.
Last month, Leo underwent surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung. Vatican officials say he has completed his two-week recovery period and requires no further treatment.
Pope Leo has lung cancer, the Vatican announces after surgery

The Vatican's new communications chief Maria Montserrat Alvarado said the pontiff was eager to begin his journey. "His doctors are very confident and he'll have plenty of medical care on board should something happen," she said.

A proposed papal address to the parliament triggered a swift rebuke from the public and politicians alike and was quickly scrapped. Instead, Uruguay's left-wing President Yamandú Orsi presided over the welcome ceremony outside Montevideo's main cathedral.
Crowds of up to 30,000 people, according to the Vatican, had lined the streets to catch a glimpse of Pope Leo as he drove past in his Popemobile.

But the crowd gathered to greet him at the central Plaza Independencia was much smaller, not even filling half the length of the vast square. Those who came were nonetheless delighted to see him and hear his message.
Pope Leo XIV is transported to the Cathedral in Montevideo, Uruguay, Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. Natacha Pisarenko/AP hide caption

The Pope wasted little time addressing Uruguay's secular traditions and its liberal laws on abortion and euthanasia. Uruguay was the first country in Latin America to legalize euthanasia through legislation, and, in 2012, became the second in the region to legalize abortion, after Cuba.
Speaking in Spanish, Leo emphasized the importance of protecting family life and delivered a pointed criticism of both laws.
He said: "It is everyone's responsibility to ensure that each person can live with dignity, receive the care they need, and be accompanied until the natural end of his or her life."

It's a puzzling choice for the first leg of the pope's anticipated return to South America, where he spent two decades in Peru, first as a missionary then as Bishop of the coastal city of Chiclayo. Uruguay, a small nation of around 3.5 million people, where adoring crowds will be small, is famously Latin America's most secular nation.

When asked why go to Uruguay at all, given the high rate of atheists and strict separation of church and state, communications chief Alvarado answered simply, "Why Not?" Adding, "the Gospel is meant to go everywhere."

Few welcome banners are seen throughout the capital Montevideo, except for large posters of a waving Pope Leo adorning city churches. A huge banner drapes down the facade of the Blessed Sacrament Church, in Montevideo's upscale Pocitos neighborhood, where 70-year old retiree Ana Maria Saprissa was heading for quiet prayer.
We are thankful, agradecida , she says that the pontiff is coming to visit. "His visit gives us such joy because … he remembered us all here in this tiny country that has so many needs," she says.
body_zh: 教皇利奥十四世回南美：乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁 : NPR
教皇利奥十四世回南美：乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁 教皇利奥十四世开始了肺癌手术后的首次南美之旅。 12天的旅程，他去了乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁，在那里度过了20年。
2026 年 11 月 6 日星期五，教皇利奥十四世在乌拉圭蒙得维的亚独立广场会见乌拉圭总统亚曼杜·奥尔西后挥手致意。
乌拉圭蒙得维的亚——教皇利奥十四世已抵达南美洲，开始为期 12 天的三个国家之旅，这将是他迄今为止最长、影响最深远的旅行，也是他接受肺癌手术后的首次重大海外访问。
一路上，Leo 将乘坐 12 趟航班，其中包括两次直升机之旅，发表 36 场演讲，并访问 10 个城市，其中包括海拔超过 11,000 英尺的秘鲁库斯科。即使是最热情的旅行者也会在那里经历高原反应，并可能需要补充氧气。
上个月，利奥接受了右肺下叶切除手术。梵蒂冈官员表示，他已经完成了两周的康复期，不需要进一步治疗。
梵蒂冈手术后宣布教皇利奥患有肺癌
梵蒂冈新任通讯主管玛丽亚·蒙特塞拉特·阿尔瓦拉多表示，教皇渴望开始他的旅程。 “他的医生非常有信心，如果发生什么事情，他将在船上得到充足的医疗护理，”她说。
教皇向议会发表讲话的提议迅速遭到公众和政界人士的谴责，并很快被废弃。相反，乌拉圭左翼总统亚曼杜·奥尔西在蒙得维的亚主大教堂外主持了欢迎仪式。
据梵蒂冈称，多达 3 万人聚集在街道两旁，只为一睹教皇利奥开着他的教皇专车经过时的样子。
但聚集在中央独立广场迎接他的人群却少得多，甚至还不到这个巨大广场的一半长度。尽管如此，那些来的人还是很高兴见到他并听到他的信息。
2026 年 11 月 6 日星期五，教皇利奥十四世被送往乌拉圭蒙得维的亚大教堂。Natacha Pisarenko/美联社隐藏标题栏
教皇几乎没有浪费时间讨论乌拉圭的世俗传统及其关于堕胎和安乐死的自由主义法律。乌拉圭是拉丁美洲第一个通过立法将安乐死合法化的国家，并于2012年成为该地区继古巴之后第二个将堕胎合法化的国家。
利奥用西班牙语强调了保护家庭生活的重要性，并对这两项法律提出了尖锐的批评。
他说：“每个人都有责任确保每个人都能有尊严地生活，得到所需的护理，并得到陪伴，直到生命的自然结束。”
对于教皇预期返回南美洲的第一站来说，这是一个令人费解的选择，他在秘鲁度过了二十年，首先担任传教士，然后担任沿海城市奇克拉约的主教。乌拉圭是一个人口约 350 万的小国，崇拜的人群也很少，但却是众所周知的拉丁美洲最世俗的国家。
当被问及为什么要去乌拉圭，考虑到无神论者比例很高以及政教严格分离时，通讯主管阿尔瓦拉多简单地回答说：“为什么不呢？”补充道，“福音应该传到任何地方。”
首都蒙得维的亚几乎看不到欢迎横幅，除了装饰城市教堂的挥舞着教皇利奥的大幅海报。蒙得维的亚波西托斯高档社区的圣体教堂外墙上悬挂着一面巨大的横幅，70 岁的退休人员安娜·玛丽亚·萨普里萨 (Ana Maria Saprissa) 正在那里安静地祈祷。
我们很感激，agradecida，她说教皇要来拜访。 “他的来访给我们带来了如此多的快乐，因为……他记得我们在这个有如此多需求的小国，”她说。

title_en: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
title_zh: 乌尔达铁路灾难后，西班牙铁路当局面临欧洲欺诈调查
summary: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.
summary_zh: 检察官开始调查欧盟用于升级西班牙铁路线的资金，该铁路线发生火车事故，造成 69 人死亡。
body_en: European Union prosecutors have begun investigating the possible misuse of EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people last week.
Prosecutors backed by a special unit of Spain's Guardia Civil security force said they were conducting the inquiry at the offices of Adif rail infrastructure authority and rail safety agency AESF.
The 28 October accident on the Madrid-Seville high-speed line was one of the worst railway disasters in Europe this century.
It is the second EU fraud inquiry opened into Spain's railways this year, after 46 people were killed on the same line at Adamuz in January.

Last week, a train operated by state-owned operator Renfe ploughed into the back of a stationary train belonging to private Spanish company Iryo outside the village of Urda, around 130km (80 miles) south of Madrid.

The LZB communication system that monitors the position of trains had gone down, and the Renfe train had been given the all clear to start running at normal speed, even though the Iryo train ahead of it had been unable to restart.
The two accidents nine months apart on the same line have claimed 115 lives and dozens more injuries.
Shock of rail tragedy gives way to sorrow and outrage in politically divided Spain
Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash

The European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) said on Friday it had begun conducting investigative measures at Spain's rail authorities "after the opening of an investigation into possible fraud affecting EU funds , external allocated to the renovation and upgrading of safety, signalling and communications systems on the Madrid-Seville high-speed railway line".
The EPPO highlighted high public interest in the case, but said no further details would be made public.

As part of the process, a Spanish judge assigned to the case has to ensure the investigation complies with legal safeguards, including authorising any measures that might involve house searches or phone-tapping.

The Urda disaster has damaged the Socialist-led government of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez ahead of a 29 November general election and the party is trailing the conservative People's Party (PP) in most opinion polls.
Close Sánchez ally Óscar Puente resigned this week as transport minister, after seeing two deadly accidents on his watch this year.
The PP and far-right Vox say Puente's resignation is not enough and they have demanded that Sánchez resign too.
Many people in Spain have now become wary of taking the train, with reports of widespread cancellations and empty station platforms.
A funeral for the 69 victims at Urda will take place on Tuesday at Toledo cathedral, in the same province that the disaster happened.
Puente's successor, Carlos Cuerpo, has vowed to take all necessary measures to "restore the confidence of Spaniards in our high-speed rail".
Cuerpo met survivors of January's Adamuz disaster on Friday and they handed him a list of 11 demands for improving safety on Spain's railways.
body_zh: 欧盟检察官已开始调查欧盟资金是否被滥用，该资金原本用于升级西班牙铁路线，上周该铁路线发生火车事故，造成 69 人死亡。
在西班牙国民警卫队特别部门支持下的检察官表示，他们正在阿迪夫铁路基础设施管理局和铁路安全机构 AESF 的办公室进行调查。
10月28日发生在马德里-塞维利亚高速线上的事故是本世纪欧洲最严重的铁路灾难之一。
这是欧盟今年对西班牙铁路展开的第二次欺诈调查，此前 1 月份阿达穆斯同一条线路上有 46 人死亡。
上周，一列由国有运营商 Renfe 运营的火车在马德里以南约 130 公里（80 英里）处的乌尔达村外撞上了属于西班牙私营公司 Iryo 的一列静止火车的后部。
监控列车位置的 LZB 通讯系统已经瘫痪，Renfe 列车已经解除警报，可以正常速度运行，尽管前面的 Iryo 列车无法重新启动。
相隔九个月发生在同一条线路上的两起事故已造成 115 人死亡，数十人受伤。
在政治分裂的西班牙，铁路悲剧的震惊逐渐被悲伤和愤怒所取代
致命火车事故几天后西班牙交通部长辞职
欧洲检察官办公室（EPPO）周五表示，“在对影响欧盟资金的可能欺诈行为展开调查后，它已开始对西班牙铁路当局采取调查措施，这些资金是外部分配给马德里-塞维利亚高速铁路线安全、信号和通信系统翻新和升级的资金”。
EPPO 强调公众对此案高度关注，但表示不会公开更多细节。
作为该过程的一部分，负责此案的西班牙法官必须确保调查符合法律保障，包括授权任何可能涉及入室搜查或电话窃听的措施。
乌尔达灾难在 11 月 29 日大选之前损害了总理佩德罗·桑切斯领导的社会党政府，该党在大多数民意调查中落后于保守的人民党 (PP)。
桑切斯的盟友奥斯卡·普恩特(Óscar Puente)本周辞去交通部长职务，此前他今年在任期间目睹了两起致命事故。
人民党和极右翼 Vox 表示，普恩特的辞职还不够，他们要求桑切斯也辞职。
西班牙的许多人现在对乘坐火车变得谨慎起来，有报道称火车普遍取消，站台空空如也。
乌尔达 69 名遇难者的葬礼将于周二在灾难发生的同一省份托莱多大教堂举行。
普恩特的继任者卡洛斯·库尔波誓言要采取一切必要措施“恢复西班牙人对我们高铁的信心”。
周五，库尔波会见了 1 月份阿达穆斯灾难的幸存者，他们向他提交了一份包含 11 项改善西班牙铁路安全要求的清单。

title_en: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
title_zh: 肺癌手术几周后，教皇开始了漫长的拉丁美洲之行
summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
summary_zh: 上个月切除了部分肺部的教皇利奥将访问乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁。
body_en: Southern and Eastern Europe correspondent, Rome

Pope Leo XIV is beginning a lengthy trip to Latin America just three weeks after surgery for lung cancer - a tour that includes a much-anticipated "homecoming" to Peru where he was a priest for many years.

The Vatican says no extraordinary measures are being taken in relation to the Pope's health, describing him as a "71-year-old who has undergone an operation" not someone with a "permanent medical condition".

It was Leo himself who revealed last month that doctors had discovered a tumour during a routine scan. The growth was removed along with the lower lobe of his right lung and his medical team then confirmed the cancer had not spread.

At a briefing in Rome ahead of the trip, which takes in Uruguay and Argentina as well as Peru, a spokeswoman stressed that Pope Leo had "fantastic stamina" and was "extremely enthusiastic" about the schedule which he had "personally confirmed... with no changes".

"The Vatican's message with this trip is, 'that was a short episode and now we're back on track'," Professor Massimo Faggioli of Villanova University told the BBC, pointing out that the Pope has had a busy return to work since his surgery.
"We have seen him in these last few days making speeches, audiences and so on. He seems in great shape. That was important."
The 12-day tour would be demanding for anyone, though. It incorporates multiple long-haul and local flights and covers thousands of miles from the Amazon to the Andes.
The starting point will be Uruguay, where the number of Catholics has fallen away steeply in recent years and which is getting its first Papal visit in four decades.
Leo then heads for Argentina, homeland of Pope Francis, his predecessor.
"This visit is also a homage to Francis, who didn't make it to Argentina [as pope]," says Father Fernando Laguna, the rector of Santa Maria Addolorata, Argentina's national church in Rome.

"When this visit by Pope Leo was announced, it filled all of our hearts with joy," he told the BBC. "I always thought he would go, despite his illness. I don't think he ever thought of calling it off!"

The priest is installing a big screen inside the church in Rome to allow parishioners to follow all the key moments of the trip from afar. The building is already decked out with posters declaring Pope Leo is welcome in Argentina. "We're waiting for you!", one proclaims.

This leg of the Pope's journey - which includes meetings with heads of state as well as religious events - could be the most politically sensitive. President Javier Milei once called Pope Francis "evil on earth" and a "communist" for promoting a doctrine of social justice to help the poor. In turn, Argentina's bishops have criticised Milei's harsh austerity measures, making sweeping cuts to social spending.
But Milei has already welcomed Pope Leo, writing in a post on X that Argentina awaits "with immense joy". Millions are expected to turn out to greet him.
The highlight of the trip is undoubtedly saved for last, when Pope Leo reaches Peru - described by the Vatican as a return to his roots.
"He knows these streets," is how a spokeswoman put it.
Born in the US, the then Robert Prevost spent almost 20 years in Peru, on and off, and even has Peruvian citizenship. That time is seen as fundamental to shaping his papacy.
His schedule includes a return to the diocese of Chiclayo where he was ordained bishop in 2014 and remained until Francis moved him to the Vatican almost a decade later.
He will also travel to Cusco, former capital of the Inca Empire, to say Mass more than 3,000m above sea level before heading to Pucallpa in the Amazon.
body_zh: 南欧和东欧记者，罗马
教皇利奥十四世在肺癌手术后仅三周，就开始了对拉丁美洲的漫长访问，其中包括万众期待的“返乡”秘鲁，他在那里担任了多年的牧师。
梵蒂冈表示，没有针对教皇的健康采取任何特别措施，称他是一名“接受过手术的71岁老人”，而不是患有“永久性健康状况”的人。
利奥本人上个月透露，医生在例行扫描中发现了肿瘤。肿瘤连同他的右肺下叶一起被切除，他的医疗团队随后证实癌症没有扩散。
此次行程将访问乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁，在罗马举行的新闻发布会上，一位女发言人强调，教皇利奥拥有“惊人的耐力”，并对他“亲自确认的行程……没有任何改变”感到“非常热情”。
维拉诺瓦大学的马西莫·法吉奥利教授告诉英国广播公司：“梵蒂冈此次访问传达的信息是，‘那是一个短暂的插曲，现在我们又回到了正轨’。”他指出，教皇手术后返回工作岗位一直很忙碌。
“过去几天我们看到他发表演讲、观众等等。他看起来状态很好。这很重要。”
不过，12 天的旅程对任何人来说都是艰巨的。它包含多个长途和本地航班，覆盖从亚马逊到安第斯山脉的数千英里。
起点将是乌拉圭，该国的天主教徒人数近年来急剧下降，而教皇四十年来首次访问该国。
随后，利奥前往前任教皇方济各的祖国阿根廷。
“这次访问也是对方济各的致敬，他没有以教皇身份来到阿根廷，”位于罗马的阿根廷国家教堂圣玛丽亚阿多洛拉塔教堂的教区费尔南多·拉古纳神父说。
他告诉英国广播公司：“当利奥教皇此次访问的消息被宣布时，我们所有人的心中都充满了喜悦。” “尽管他生病了，但我一直以为他会去。我认为他从来没有想过取消！”
神父正在罗马教堂内安装一个大屏幕，让教区居民可以从远处观看旅途中的所有关键时刻。这座建筑已经贴满了海报，宣布教皇利奥在阿根廷受到欢迎。 “我们在等你！”，其中一人宣称。
教皇旅程的这一阶段——包括与国家元首的会面以及宗教活动——可能是政治上最敏感的。哈维尔·米莱总统曾称教皇方济各是“地球上的邪恶”和“共产主义者”，因为他提倡帮助穷人的社会正义学说。反过来，阿根廷主教们批评了米莱严厉的紧缩措施，大幅削减了社会支出。
但米雷已经欢迎了教皇利奥，她在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道，阿根廷“怀着巨大的喜悦”等待着。预计将有数百万人前来迎接他。
这次旅行的亮点无疑被留到了最后，即教皇利奥抵达秘鲁——梵蒂冈称其为回归根源。
“他熟悉这些街道，”一位发言人说道。
出生于美国的罗伯特·普雷沃斯特断断续续地在秘鲁度过了近20年，甚至拥有秘鲁公民身份。那段时间被视为塑造他的教皇职位的基础。
他的日程安排包括返回奇克拉约教区，并于 2014 年被任命为主教，直到近十年后方济各将他调往梵蒂冈。
他还将前往印加帝国前首都库斯科，在海拔3000m以上的地方做弥撒，然后前往亚马逊地区的普卡尔帕。
